title: Polynomial-Time Certificate Normalization
statement: For a function $f$ from Boolean lists to Boolean lists and a certificate that $f$ is computable in polynomial time, the certificate obtained by taking the same machine and polynomial uses that polynomial, evaluated at the input length, as its time bound.
hypotheses_covered: A function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists.
A polynomial-time computability certificate for the function.
